recipes.name: Beef Asado
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53071. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 0.	Combine beef, crushed peppercorn, soy sauce, vinegar, dried bay leaves, lemon, and tomato sauce. Mix well. Marinate beef for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 1.	Put the marinated beef in a cooking pot along with remaining marinade. Add water. Let boil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 2.	Add Knorr Beef Cube. Stir. Cover the pot and cook for 40 minutes in low heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 3.	Turn the beef over. Add tomato paste. Continue cooking until beef tenderizes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 4.	Heat oil in a pan. Fry the potato until it browns. Turn over and continue frying the opposite side. Remove from the pan and place on a clean plate. Do the same with the carrots.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 5.	Save 3 tablespoons of cooking oil from the pan where the potato was fried. Saute onion and garlic until onion softens.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 6.	Pour-in the sauce from the beef stew. Let boil. Add the beef. Cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 7.	Add butter and let it melt. Continue cooking until the sauce reduces to half.

recipes.name: Beef Caldereta
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53070. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 0.	Heat oil in a cooking pot. Saute onion and garlic until onion softens

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 1.	Add beef. Saute until the outer part turns light brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 2.	Add soy sauce. Pour tomato sauce and water. Let boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 3.	Add Knorr Beef Cube. Cover the pressure cooker. Cook for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 4.	Pan-fry carrot and potato until it browns. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 5.	Add chili pepper, liver spread and peanut butter. Stir.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 6.	Add bell peppers, fried potato and carrot. Cover the pot. Continue cooking for 5 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 7.	Season with salt and ground black pepper. Serve.

recipes.name: Beef Mechado
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53068. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 0.	Make the beef tenderloin marinade by combining soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, olive oil, sugar, salt, and ground black pepper in a large bowl. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 1.	Add the cubed beef tenderloin to the bowl with the beef tenderloin marinade. Gently toss to coat the beef. Let it stay for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 2.	Using a metal or bamboo skewer, assemble the beef kebob by skewering the vegetables and marinated beef tenderloin.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 3.	Heat-up the grill and start grilling the beef kebobs for 3 minutes per side. This will give you a medium beef that is juicy and tender on the inside. Add more time if you want your beef well done, but it will be less tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 4.	Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with Saffron rice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 5.	Share and enjoy!

recipes.name: Bistek
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53069. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 0.	Marinate beef in soy sauce, lemon (or calamansi), and ground black pepper for at least 1 hour. Note: marinate overnight for best result

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 1.	Heat the cooking oil in a pan then pan-fry half of the onions until the texture becomes soft. Set aside

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 2.	Drain the marinade from the beef. Set it aside. Pan-fry the beef on the same pan where the onions were fried for 1 minute per side. Remove from the pan. Set aside

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 3.	Add more oil if needed. Saute garlic and remaining raw onions until onion softens.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 4.	Pour the remaining marinade and water. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 5.	Add beef. Cover the pan and simmer until the meat is tender. Note: Add water as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 6.	Season with ground black pepper and salt as needed. Top with pan-fried onions.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 7.	Transfer to a serving plate. Serve hot. Share and Enjoy!

recipes.name: Eggplant Adobo
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53073. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1.	Slice 1 lb. small Japanese or Italian eggplant (about 3) into quarters lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2"-wide pieces. Place in a medium bowl. Add 1 Tbsp. sugar, 1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. Morton kosher salt, and ½ tsp. freshly ground black pepper. Toss to evenly coat eggplant and let sit at room temperature at least 20 minutes and up to 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2.	Peel and thinly slice 8 garlic cloves. Add 3 Tbsp. vegetable oil and half of garlic to a medium Dutch oven or other heavy pot. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until light golden and crisp, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer garlic chips to a plate; season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Place 4 oz. ground pork in same pot and break up into small pieces with wooden spoon. Season with ¼ tsp. Diamond Crystal or Morton kosher salt and cook, undisturbed, until deeply browned underneath, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to another plate, leaving fat behind in the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Place eggplant on a clean kitchen towel and blot away any moisture the salt has drawn out.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Working in batches and adding more oil if needed, cook eggplant in the same pot until lightly browned, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate with pork.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Pour 1½ cups of water into the pot and scrape up browned bits from the bottom with a wooden spoon. Add remaining garlic, 3 Tbsp. coconut vinegar or unseasoned rice vinegar, 2 Tbsp. soy sauce, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp. freshly ground black pepper, and remaining 1 Tbsp. sugar. Bring to a simmer, then return pork and eggplant to pot. Reduce heat to medium-low, partially cover, and simmer until eggplant is tender and silky and sauce is reduced by half, 20–25 minutes. Taste and season with more salt and pepper and add a little more sugar if needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Top with garlic chips and serve with cooked white rice.
